import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):

    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[0]+params[1]*x+params[2]*v+params[3]*v*np.abs(v)+params[4]*x*x
            +(params[5]+params[6]*x+params[7]*v)*C+params[8]*S)
